rule: # Curated subsystem rules, read by tools/assign_subsystems.py (docs/architecture.md says
# what each subsystem covers). Rules, strongest first:
#   class NAME         the methods of NAME, and of the classes derived from it (RTTI bases)
#                      that have no class or namespace rule of their own
#   namespace PREFIX   every namespace that is PREFIX or starts with PREFIX::
#   range LO-HI        a function in the global namespace in [LO, HI), for a whole source
#                      file; files start at the dynamic initializers (static_init_*)
#   import DLL[!NAME]  a function in the global namespace that uses the import; only
#                      imports that one subsystem owns (the registry, for one, is used by
#                      the UI for window positions as well as by WinMain for settings)
# Functions no rule reaches get their subsystem from their callers, their neighbours in
# the address space and their callees.
